verdict.rationale: Perplexity is an API platform, so an official SDK is a fair ask, but the evidence never names a first-party SDK package. Developers can still build against existing SDK tooling through its OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and a published OpenAPI spec supports generating clients; the documented Agent API features (structured output, model fallback, profiles) can be called programmatically. missing for 10: explicit official Perplexity SDK packages (e.g., Python/TypeScript), SDK installation and reference docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
